formula: const deviceRisk = { 'desktop': 15, 'laptop': 25, 'tablet': 20, 'smartphone': 30, 'smart-tv': 35 }; const protectionBonus = { 'none': 0, 'camera-cover': -10, 'mic-disable': -8, 'both': -20 }; const antivirusBonus = { 'none': 25, 'basic': 10, 'premium': -5, 'enterprise': -15 }; const updateBonus = { 'never': 20, 'quarterly': 10, 'monthly': 0, 'weekly': -10 }; const browserBonus = { 'basic': 15, 'standard': 5, 'enhanced': -5, 'maximum': -15 }; const permissionBonus = { 'never': 20, 'sometimes': 10, 'regularly': -5, 'always': -15 }; const networkBonus = { 'public': 15, 'mixed': 5, 'private': -5, 'vpn': -10 }; const suspiciousBonus = suspiciousActivity ? 25 : 0; let baseRisk = 30; let totalRisk = baseRisk + deviceRisk[deviceType] + protectionBonus[physicalProtection] + antivirusBonus[antivirusProtection] + updateBonus[softwareUpdates] + browserBonus[browserSecurity] + permissionBonus[appPermissions] + networkBonus[networkSecurity] + suspiciousBonus; totalRisk = Math.max(5, Math.min(95, totalRisk)); const riskScore = totalRisk; const riskLevel = totalRisk >= 70 ? 'High Risk' : totalRisk >= 40 ? 'Medium Risk' : 'Low Risk'; const priorityActions = (physicalProtection === 'none' ? 1 : 0) + (antivirusProtection === 'none' ? 1 : 0) + (softwareUpdates === 'never' ? 1 : 0) + (appPermissions === 'never' ? 1 : 0) + (suspiciousActivity ? 1 : 0); return { riskScore, riskLevel, priorityActions };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your webcam and microphone privacy risk by analyzing device vulnerabilities, security measures, and usage patterns. It considers physical protections, software security, permission management, and network security to provide a comprehensive risk assessment.
tips: Use physical camera covers and hardware microphone switches when not in use
Keep your operating system and software updated with latest security patches
Use Incognito Browser or privacy-focused browsers to limit tracking and malware exposure
Regularly audit and restrict camera/microphone permissions for apps and websites
Install reputable antivirus software with real-time protection
Avoid using public Wi-Fi for sensitive activities or use a VPN
Check for LED indicators when camera/microphone are active
Be cautious of suspicious emails and downloads that could contain spyware
